confounds_flagged: Speech material differs across corpora (TORGO words+sentences EN; IPVS sustained vowels/DDK/read passages IT; EasyCall voice commands IT) — a cross-corpus task-mismatch confound.

Silence/VAD: TORGO features come from the project's existing non-VAD-trimmed L9 cache; other corpora are mean-pooled over full clips. Silence dilutes the pooled feature and is a known TORGO confound (see exp 43_silence_confound). Not VAD-trimmed here; flagged.

IPVS labels are binary PD-vs-HC (no graded UPDRS/H&Y in the public release); IPVS controls mix young + elderly while all PD are older (age confound; ipvs.load(elderly_only=True) restricts to the age-matched subset).
EasyCall labels are binary dysarthric-vs-healthy (graded TOM severity is in the source paper, not the audio package).
